mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM sys_flow_node_config c INNER JOIN sys_flow_model m ON c.model_id = m.id WHERE (m.id = #{modelRef} OR m.model_key = #{modelRef}) AND c.del_flag = '0' AND (m.del_flag IS NULL OR m.del_flag = 0) AND c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY c.create_time ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT c.* FROM sys_flow_node_config c INNER JOIN sys_flow_model m ON c.model_id = m.id WHERE (m.model_key = #{modelKey} OR m.id = #{modelKey}) AND c.node_id = #{nodeId} AND c.del_flag = '0' AND (m.del_flag IS NULL OR m.del_flag = 0) AND c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY c.update_time DESC, c.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_flow_node_config SET del_flag = id, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE model_id IN ( SELECT m.id FROM sys_flow_model m WHERE (m.id = #{modelId} OR m.model_key = #{modelId}) AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (m.del_flag IS NULL OR m.del_flag = 0) ) AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND del_flag = '0'
